name: codex-goalctl
description: Codex skill for managing persisted thread goals with codex-goalctl.

interface.longDescription: Codex Goalctl provides guidance for inspecting persisted goals and managing goals on threads that accept direct external control through the codex-goalctl host command.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-goalctl to inspect a persisted goal or manage one on a directly controlled Codex thread.
